collection.title: Lotus Elise 1996 to 2001 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Lotus Elise 1996 to 2001 S1 requires a 26" wiper blade, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
